basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old veterinary technician from Austin, Texas. Outside of work, I'm passionate about woodworking and gaming, especially on my PS4 with games like Rainbow Six Siege. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, mostly from 7 PM to 10 PM. I'm in a long-term relationship and we both share a love for animals. I dislike negativity and drama in online communities, preferring to keep interactions light and positive. When I'm not online, I'm often found in my garage working on my latest woodworking project.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in animal science and have been working as a veterinary technician for about 7 years. My knowledge in woodworking comes from self-teaching through online resources and community workshops. Gaming has been a hobby since my teenage years, and I keep up with the latest updates and strategies through gaming communities.
